hooks.name: SpendWise File Structure Validator
hooks.description: After any file write, checks that the three required application files exist and warns if additional JS/CSS/HTML files are created outside the allowed paths.

action.prompt: Check that the following three files exist in the workspace root of kiro-university-project: index.html, style.css, script.js. If any are missing, report which file is missing and which task it corresponds to in tasks.md. Also verify no additional .html, .css, or .js files exist outside of .kiro/ directories. Report findings concisely.

hooks.name: SpendWise Accessibility Checker
hooks.description: After writing to index.html or style.css, checks for common accessibility issues.

action.prompt: If the file just written is index.html, check: (1) every <input> and <select> has an associated <label> with matching for/id, (2) buttons have descriptive text or aria-label, (3) dynamic regions have aria-live attributes, (4) form error containers have id attributes for aria-describedby references. Report any violations found.

hooks.name: SpendWise Spec Compliance Check
hooks.description: After writing to script.js, verifies alignment with the design document.

action.prompt: If the file just written is script.js, verify: (1) 'use strict' is present, (2) localStorage operations are wrapped in try/catch, (3) no var declarations are used, (4) calculations use stored data not DOM values, (5) the STORAGE_KEY constant is defined. Report any missing items.
